claims.claim: Incident North river North river (last night)
claims.citation: New York Herald, 19 June 1866, p. 8, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
During the heavy blow last night from SE, the ships
Philadelphia, and D H Watjen, at anchor in the North river,
dragged their anchors near to the steamships Palmyra, and
on the turn of the tide the steamer swung across the bows
of the ship, doing some considerable damage to each other.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 2 July 1866, p. 4, col. 1 (British Newspaper Archive)

claims.claim: Incident North River North River (Thursday night)
claims.verbatim:
During the heavy blow on Thursday night, from S. E., the ships
Philadelphia and D. H. Watjen, at anchor in the North River, dragged
their anchors near to the steamship Palmyra, and, on the turn of the
tide, the steamer swung across the bows of the ships, doing consider-
able damage to each other.
